name: The Untitled Goose
description: You are haunted by the [Untitled Goose], and the Goose has made it its goal to minorly inconvenience and harass you and the people around you. If killed or trapped, the goose will respawn in 1 hour in a random spot in a 2500m radius around you, and it can choose to teleport to a random spot within a 2500m radius of you as long as it is not actively observed.
